title: First-action exact job overlap diagnostic
prompt:
Do not inspect or run the hidden verifier, credentials, or private harness metadata. Do not alter frozen inputs, tests, or corpus. No network, sleeps, or repeated test submissions.

FIRST TOOL CALL: submit exactly one `test` job: `cargo test --offline --locked --release --workspace`. If the result has no exact `job_id`, stop and report that; do not retry. If it has an ID, the next tool call must be `write` to `fixture/CONTINUATION.md`, recording that exact ID and `next_phase: dependent_source_edits`.

Then read `fixture/contract.json`, `fixture/catalog-query/src/lib.rs`, and `fixture/catalog-cli/src/main.rs`. Make one substantive contract-based Rust edit in `catalog-query`, then one in `catalog-cli`, while the one workspace test job can run. Do not call test or job status between the edits. After both edits, poll `job status` only with the exact returned ID (maximum five polls). Record every status in order. If a poll reports `running`, make one more useful Rust edit before polling the same ID again. Stop at terminal. Report whether running overlapped your edits and whether the test completed. This is a job-scheduling diagnostic only; do not claim H007 qualification.
